task_title: Floor 2 Slice 3 — family-aware AI, hate ramp, feud targeting, ally defend

plan_review.notes: Concerns identified during planning: (1) Slice 1 API rename effectiveSpeedForHate must be honored — used correctly; (2) rival-detection MUST use spatial hash not O(n²) — new SpatialHashGrid built per-frame, feudCandidateLimit trims candidate list before sort; (3) friendly retaliation MUST reuse existing hit-event bus not add a parallel one — reused world.combatEvents, extended existing CombatEvent with optional sourceEid; (4) both simulation pipelines (headless src/game/ai and visual src/engine/sim, actually src/bootstrap/floor-main-scene-options) must wire the new system — done; (5) hate-band mobs already faster than the player must be unaffected — effectiveSpeedForHate returns baseSpeed in that case and getEnemySpeed's max() semantics preserve status slows.

dual_plan_synthesis.notes: Two designs considered: (A) fold everything into enemyAISystem's per-mob loop directly; (B) prepass system that stamps decisions into a WeakMap consumed by enemyAISystem. Chose (B) because it (a) keeps enemyAISystem's existing shape intact and thus limits the surface for regressions in the ~1810-line file, (b) gives tests a stable observable surface via getFamilyAIDecision(), (c) allows the lab overlay + perf test to read the same decision map, and (d) allows the retaliation state + spatial hash to be owned by one system with clear lifecycle. Trade-off: two data structures instead of inline — resolved by putting them all in a single file (familyFeudSystem.ts).

multi_model_review.notes: Determinism check: all RNG via world.rng (none needed for this slice — tie-breaks use lower eid). Date.now: none. Spatial hash budget: enforced by trim in findNearestRival and asserted by family-feud-perf.test.ts. Cross-referenced ADR 0040 D5 (band-keyed AI foe-set) and ADR 0024 (engagement budget).

rounds.notes: Round 1: (1) queryRadius returns REUSED buffer — added explicit .slice(0, limit) before iteration; (2) retaliation cursor needed to not re-arm on replay — added per-world combatEventCursor WeakMap and start = min(cursor, events.length) to be safe on world reset.

verification.wired_systems: PASS (familyFeudSystem wired into both src/game/ai/simulation-step.ts and src/bootstrap/floor-main-scene-options.ts preSystems)
